claims.claim_en: The verb اتَّبَعَ (root ت ب ع) is in the Form VIII (افتعل / اِفْتَعَلَ) — a derived pattern indicating following/taking as model (a reflexive/derivative verbal flavor).

claims.claim_en: Proper name 'Allah' — the divine/theonym; conventionally associated with the root 'اله' in traditional lexica, but the word is lexicalized and treated as a special divine name rather than a regular triliteral derivation.
claims.needs_review_reason: Theonymic/root analysis of "اللَّه" is exceptional and debated in lexicography; treating it as derived from 'اله' is a conventional (not strictly morphological) assignment.
